is_anopheles.evidence: Study evaluated Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. arabiensis, An. gambiae s.s., and An. coluzzii) collected from Bobo-Dioulasso, Burkina Faso (Page 1, Abstract; Page 4, Molecular processing).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Paper reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (kdr-West) and L995S (kdr-East) mutations (Page 4, 'Detection of kdr mutation (Kdr-West and Kdr-East)'; Page 8, Table 1).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 on page 8 provides sample sizes (N) and explicit counts for genotypes (995L 995L, 995L 995F, 995F 995F for kdr-West; 995L 995L, 995L 995S, 995S 995S for kdr-East) as well as allele frequencies for An. arabiensis and An. gambiae s.s. across six sites.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquito larvae were collected from natural breeding sites in six neighborhoods of Bobo-Dioulasso, Burkina Faso in 2025 and reared to adults (F0) for bioassays and molecular characterization (Page 3, 'Collection and rearing mosquito larvae').

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical research paper reporting original field collections, WHO bioassays, molecular species identification, kdr genotyping, and sporozoite infection testing.

sub_country_location.evidence: Collections took place in six distinct neighborhoods in Bobo-Dioulasso (Kua, Sarfalao, Sabaribougou, Dogona, Farakan, Kodeni) with geographic coordinates given (11°10'37" N, 4°17'52" W; Page 2, Study area).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Larval collections were conducted during the rainy season from May to July 2025, and HLCs were performed between July and September 2024 (Page 3, 4).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine primary field study reporting original mosquito collections in Bobo-Dioulasso.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts, sample sizes, species breakdowns, and bioassay mortality rates are provided in full within the main paper text and tables (Tables 1-3, Figs 2-4).

assessment.summary: This study evaluated insecticide susceptibility, kdr target-site mutations (L995F and L995S), species composition, and malaria transmission metrics in Anopheles gambiae s.l. across six neighborhoods of Bobo-Dioulasso, Burkina Faso. PCR genotyping of 360 bioassay-tested mosquitoes revealed high frequencies of Vgsc L995F (0.533-0.745 in An. arabiensis) and presence of L995S (up to 0.421 in An. arabiensis), with complete extractable genotype counts supplied per site in Table 1.
